propositions: Eight CI lanes lacked per-test hang guards despite one or more tests potentially deadlocking and blocking job completion behind lack of traceback or culprit identification.
Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated per-lane from observed historical runtime data with generous allowance for live-service variance, not copied as a blanket value across all lanes.

The parity assertion must detect pytest invocation across all four command forms (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed python) and reject any lacking both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags.

Test lanes invoking pytest in .github/workflows files must each carry an auditable YAML comment documenting the per-lane budget and the evidence (historical runs, observed durations, or design rationale) that justifies it.

A detection rule matching pytest commands at shell command boundaries must filter out false positives (pip install pytest, shell comments, argument text) to avoid flagging non-pytest-lane steps and ensure no future lane ships unguarded.
